notes.title: Balance adjustment
notes.content:
Balance adjustment:
·The number of coins in the starting chest has increased by 5
·Improved farmers' gold coin income, now the expected daily gold coin output is 1

Others:
·Completed some text translations
·Fixed a bug that caused the builder's clothing and body to be misaligned

There are currently two known bugs:
1. Horseknights sometimes encounter a problem of searching for enemies, and when the enemy enters the attack range, they will not launch a charge. This bug can currently only be resolved by reloading the save. (The primary issue to be addressed at the moment, I will fix it as soon as possible)

2. The patrolman (the guy who picks up coins, I never thought of a suitable title for him) sometimes encounters a picking bug after arriving at the coin location. He cannot pick up coins and walks in place. If the player picks up the coin at this time, the patrolman will switch to the next target.


In September, I plan to redo the current resource system and complete the boss battles for the level. The remaining time will be used to optimize the details and then add some other creatures and decors.

notes.title: Solved a problem about save loading
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where your old game save was not fully loaded. 
If you had started a new game after the last update, you wouldn't have encountered this bug.

notes.title: Update on August
notes.content: [p]Newly added:[/p][p]· Added Mounted Knights, powerful ally units that can charge through enemy formations during defense, significantly enhancing the player's ability to handle large enemy groups in the late game.(Horses can  be purchased at the Stable, similar to buying weapons and tools from the Blacksmith. Villagers will equip them)[/p][p]· Added new Elite Units: the Dwarf and the Paladin. They can be recruited from the Viking Tribe once certain conditions are met. Elite units feature unique additional mechanics.[/p][p]· The Blacksmith in the Viking Tribe can now help you upgrade the attack skill of Swordsman units. This interaction becomes available after meeting some conditions.[/p][p]· Added a new enemy unit:  Elite Orc, known for its toughness and aggressiveness.[/p][p]· The beggar Camp can be upgraded now  after integrating it into your fief.[/p][p]· Crop yield is reduced during winter. Make sure to prepare accordingly in advance.[/p][p]· Randomized the contents and locations of forest treasure chests.[/p][p]· Added an explosion effect that triggers when the Orc wizard's projectile hits a unit.[/p][p]· Added shadow effects for units that similar to the player character's shadow.[/p][p]· Added a new construction complete sound effect that plays when building or upgrading walls and structures finishes.[/p][p]· Added purchase and drop sound effects for tools and weapon equipment, enhancing feedback when acquiring items.[/p][p]· Added a sound effect for the generation of background walls.[/p][p]· Enriched the forest background with more vegetation. (I was planning to add seasonal animals in the future to make the forest feel more alive.)[/p][p]· Added some miscellaneous oddities.[/p][p]Changes & Balancing:[/p][p]· Modified the layout of the top resource UI bar. It now displays the specific count of different unit types for both side.[/p][p]· Reworked the maximum durability for walls at all upgrade stages. Health now doubles with each upgrade. Higher-level walls are now more durable, while lower-level walls are more fragile compared to before.[/p][p]· Increased the base HP of Monster Spawnstones.[/p][p]· Spawnstones will not counterattack during the player's first attack (This should make the early game rhythm smoother).[/p][p]· The strength of the Spawnstone's counterattack now scales with the number of spawnstones already destroyed.[/p][p]· Increased the base attack power of Mushroom Monsters; it is now equal to that of Wolves.[/p][p]· The player character can no longer attack enemies initially and must learn this ability later.[/p][p]· Slightly increased the player character's base movement speed (by approximately 15%).[/p][p]· Adjusted the highlight effect when the player character enters the forest (It's now more noticeable than before, and a previous shadow misalignment bug has been fixed).[/p][p]· Optimized the Archer's target acquisition logic at night. They can now detect and turn around to shoot enemies approaching from behind (This was a rare occurrence in previous versions where Archers couldn't detect enemies coming from behind during night).[/p][p]· Decreased the base HP of Swordsmen.[/p][p]· Increased the base HP of Knights.[/p][p]· Reduced the food production rate of Peasants. Food is no longer as abundant and can't be squandered as freely as before.[/p][p]· Optimized the Peasants' save logic. The state of the farmlands they are cultivating is now also saved. (This prevents peasants from needing to re-cultivate land after loading a save).[/p][p]· Nuns can now do healing at night.[/p][p]· Orc wizard's projectiles now disappear after flying for a certain duration (if they don't hit any hostile units).[/p][p]· Adjusted the quantity of starting resources in the fief's initial treasure chest.[/p][p]· Adjusted the initial spawning logic for level events and Monster Spawnstones.[/p][p]· Tweaked the UI display for Victory and Defeat screens.[/p][p]· Adjusted the Main Menu UI layout and optimized German text display (The panel would previously overstretch to the right due to the longer text length. While not a complete fix, the stretching is now less noticeable. A simple and effective solution seems to be implementing text wrapping, which is also how the Steam client handles German UI. I will try this method in the future update).[/p][p]Bug Fixes:[/p][p]Fixed a bug that prevented NPCs from correctly initiating pursuit when monsters entered their chase range during the day.[/p][p]Fixed a bug that prevented the Orc wizard's projectile from changing direction.[/p][p]Fixed a bug that caused a game error when the Coin Collector NPC was attacked.[/p][p]Fixed a bug where the Slime's attack hitbox was larger than its visual attack animation indicated.[/p][p]Fixed a bug that caused inconsistent movement speed when running left vs. right.[/p][p]Fixed a bug where the ingame menu interface would not reset after closing the Pause UI.[/p][p]Fixed a bug that prevented the roadside lamp on one side from being triggered again after a failed player march.[/p][p]Optimizations:[/p][p]Optimized unit code, significantly reducing their performance cost! (This was the biggest achievement of the month, reflecting a deeper understanding of code for me and a fundamental improvement in efficiency. Previous review mentioned lag with many units, which discouraged adding new content until this better optimization method was found. Indeed, all the content in this update was added subsequently.)[/p][p]Optimized the player character's attack hit detection for more natural swing animations.[/p]

notes.title: Update on August 20
notes.content:
Added many new things
This update is for testing purposes, and I will release the specific update content after the testing and optimization

notes.title: Update on July 25
notes.content:
Change:
·When the fief range covers Forest people and Viking villages, the trading among merchants is no longer about exchanging resources for coins, but rather coins for resources, with an exchange rate of 2 gold coins for 1 resource. 
(I found this to be a great direction because I have been thinking about how to utilise the positions of various events in the forest to make an influence on the game. Previously, for players, the closer the events were, the better, because it saved running time and made it easier for players to interact. Now there may be some slight tilts. Afterwards, I will also try to design different stages of effects for each event to make the game more interesting.)

notes.title: Update on July 11
notes.content:
Changes:

·Unified the enemy search range and the daytime wandering range of all ally units

·Modified the generation logic of some initial resources and events. Now the generation of bigtrees is more reasonable (while keeping the quantity basically unchanged) and monster's spawnstones are no longer 100% symmetrical

Bug fixes:

·Fixed a bug where when a villager died on their way to pick up a tool, the tool would automatically be marked as picked up, which prevents other villagers from picking it up again.

notes.title: Update on July 10
notes.content:
Change:

· One more villager at the beginning of the game. Originally there were two, but now when player upgrade the initial broken camp, a villager will appear. So, on the first day of the game, even without recruiting additional villagers, two archers and one builder can be equipped. (This reduces the pressure at the beginning. I think this change will make the game more friendly for players who are not familiar with the game, especially those who are entering the game for the first time.)

· When night falls, delay generating monsters by 3 seconds so that soldiers can return to the back of the walls in time. (This change can avoid unnecessary personnel losses that occur every night when the wall is too close to the monster spawnstone.)

notes.title: Update on July 9
notes.content:
newly added:
·Added some sound effects, including mark sound for confirming construction upgrades and sound effects for collecting wood and stone.

Change:
·Remote units, like archers, and priests have 1-1.5 seconds of attack cooldown after completing their attacks, instead of immediately attacking, which makes the attack rhythm more staggered and comfortable to look at.. (Actually, there have been attack cooldowns in the previous code, but today I just realized that this code did not actually trigger, so to some extent, this can also be considered a bug fix)

·Correspondingly, the average attack power of the monsters was lowered to maintain the original balance.

·Adjusted the generation interval of monsters, with stronger monsters having a longer generation interval (+1s) and weaker monsters having a slightly shorter generation interval (-0.1s).

notes.title: Update on July 8
notes.content:
newly added:
· The priest's lightning attack adds the light effect (which looks much more reasonable)

Change:
· Modified the layer display order of some buildings, now monsters will not be displayed behind churches and hoe shop.

Bug fixes:
· Fixed a bug where the sky did not return to normal brightness after the rainy weather ended

notes.title: Update on July 7
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596478/54e24811ebe2e014daed12fed2569cede9f7f8f4.png"][/img]newly added:

Bug fixes:
·Fixed a bug where the monster generation frequency was too fast. When days counter are high, the mushroom monsters and wolves at the end will all be generated in one breath (normally, the generation interval is 0.5-1.0 seconds).[/p]

notes.title: Update on July 6

·After the first spawnstone is destroyed, the monster's increase in strength decreases. (Restore to normal level after the second one is destroyed).

notes.title: Update on June 30th
notes.content:
New:
・Added attack cooldowns for monsters, resulting in more natural combat animations (effectively reduces attack frequency).
・Added onboarding tooltips explaining resource marking and cancellation controls.
・New Stable building and Slime unit introduced! Unlocks after upgrading to WoodenBase and reaching sufficient territory size.
⠀→ Stables produce 1 Slime daily for displaying ●ω●
⠀→ Functionality in development—speculate on their purpose!

Changes:
・Orc Warrior HP increased by 10
⠀→ No longer dies to a single Lightning Strike by priest
⠀→ (Arrows deal 10 damage; now requires one additional hit)

Bug Fixes:
・Fixed Attack Potion values
⠀→ Corrected accidental extra zero in data entry
⠀→ (Previously inflated damage significantly)

notes.title: Update on June 29th
notes.content:
New:
・Added auto-hide UI when player remains idle for a period.
・Press W or ↑ to cancel building/upgrade placements and refund resources. (Previously, pressing W or ↑ could unmark resources, but I did not provide any written notice, so many of you may not know this function)

Changes:
・Slightly adjusted Pause Menu UI layout for better clarity.

Bug Fixes:
・Fixed misaligned language button in Pause Menu UI.

notes.title: Update on June 28th
notes.content:
New:
・Added notice that player loses food when attacked. A text prompt now appears upon taking damage for the first time.

Changes:
・Adjusted initial resource spawn logic: Big Trees will no longer spawn near monster spawn points (prevents walls being built too close to enemy spawnstone).
・Optimized spawn logic for the "coin for wood" event: Increased probability of it appearing near the player's starting territory.

Bug Fixes:
・Fixed a bug where monsters could spasm in place during night marches.

Dev Preview:
✨ New units (allies & enemies), events, and enhanced weather system are in production!
Expect them in 2-3 days! (●ˇ∀ˇ●)

notes.title: Update (2) on June 27th
notes.content:
New:

· Added a small chance to drop 1 extra gold coin when gathering resources.

· Implemented Wall Upgrade Restrictions: Stone Walls now require upgrading the Main Base to the WoodenBase first. (This prevents some players from excessively upgrading walls in early game, which wastes resources.)

Changes:

· Optimized Builder AI: Builders now prioritize summoning nearby builders when heading to upgrade/construct buildings.

· Adjusted the rendering order of the Wanderer Camp and Walls. The camp will no longer obscure the walls.

Bug Fixes:

· Fixed a bug where sound effects lingered after closing the troop selection interface.

notes.title: Update on June 27th
notes.content:
New:

·Added new "coin for wood" event mechanics: After sunrise, the wood required to exchange for coins is reduced by 1 (but will never drop below one piece).

Changes:

·Optimized the troop selection interface. Adjusting troop counts now provides smoother operation and enhanced audiovisual feedback.

·Slightly increased the label size of the day counter in the top-right corner.

Bug Fixes:

·Fixed a bug where the gold coin icon persisted incorrectly on the teleporter. Coins will no longer obstruct the cute cube in the center.

notes.title: Update on June 26th
notes.content:
1. Optimized the performance of ordinary villagers.
 (Previously, there was a vicious bug that caused the game to become laggy when the number of villagers exceeded 7-8. Now it won't be like this anymore!)

2. Merge the two treasure chests at the beginning into one to avoid some players forgetting to pick up the initial food and triggering a famine ending at the beginning.

3. Optimized the generation logic of the background fence

4.Added the following sound effects:
Player character attack sound effects, cloak swinging sound effects while running, great bushy rustling sound effects (making your movements in the forest more immersive!), orc wizard casting sound effects
